title: "FINAL STAND
storySoFar: One week until Warzone. CHAOS dominates: RAZE challenges Iron Sovereign for the World Title in a Winner-Take-All War. Luxe fully betrayed Apex Predator to join CHAOS; the Corporate Elite is fractured. Riot King and the Last Stand (Ghostface, Chain Reaction) prepare for their final stand. Chain Reaction chases the Cruiserweight Title for the second time—his redemption arc nears payoff. Scarlet Widow remains undefeated and will dethrone Velvet Thunder for the Women's Title. Ghostface's cryptic hints about sacrifice and the federation's darkest secrets remain unresolved. Chrome Warrior aids the Last Stand, hinting at a hidden agenda that defies his CHAOS alignment. Next week, the anarchists seize control—or the old guard makes one last stand.

segments.title: Cold Open: CHAOS Issues Its Final Ultimatum

lines: Next week, I take the World Title from the so-called Sovereign.
Everything changes. The old guard falls, or it bleeds.
One final stand, old man—and then WZW belongs to us.
The federation's corruption ends at Warzone!
Iron Sovereign, your throne crumbles. Riot King, your knees will buckle.
CHAOS is the future. Accept it, or perish in the ashes of your failures!

segments.recap: RAZE and Reverend Vice storm the broadcast to deliver their ultimatum one week before Warzone: submit to the New Order or be destroyed.

segments.title: Match 1: Ghostface vs. Cipher—Last Stand vs. CHAOS

lines: Stay focused, Ghost! This is ours!
The New Order will consume you!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Ghostface and Cipher lock up—the Last Stand against CHAOS's silent strategist!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: Reverend Vice is barking orders at Cipher from the aisle. This is the faction's brains on the line.

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Ghostface fires up! The Haunt is coming!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: The Specter defeats CHAOS! The Last Stand draws first blood one week before Warzone!

segments.recap: Ghostface takes on Cipher in a high-stakes clash as the Last Stand makes its final stand against the anarchist faction.

segments.title: Interview: Riot King's Knees, Ghostface's Sacrifice

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: Riot King—your knees. You can barely walk. Why put yourself through this one more time?

exchange.speaker: riot_king
exchange.text: Because this federation needs someone to stand. Even broken, I stand.

exchange.speaker: vic_steele
exchange.text: And you, Ghostface? What does the Specter predict for Warzone?

exchange.speaker: ghostface
exchange.text: The old will fall. But not before one last roar. That roar is coming, Vic.

segments.recap: Vic Steele corners Riot King and Ghostface backstage about the physical toll and what victory costs the aging last hope of WZW.

segments.title: Match 2: Chain Reaction vs. Silver Bullet—The Kid vs. the Champion

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Here we go! Chain Reaction finally gets his redemption moment against Silver Bullet and the Cruiserweight Title!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: The kid is flying circles around the champion—but Reverend Vice is calling the shots from the aisle.

moments.speaker: chain_reaction
moments.line: This is mine! This is MY moment!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Wait—Cipher hits the ring! CHAOS is destroying the kid!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: Riot King makes the save! The Last Stand is protecting its own!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: No contest! CHAOS refuses to let the kid win clean, but the Last Stand draws another line—at Warzone, all bets are off!

segments.recap: Chain Reaction chases the Cruiserweight Title for the final time as he battles the CHAOS-aligned Silver Bullet in a no-disqualification affair.

segments.title: Match 3: Velvet Thunder vs. Scarlet Widow (Non-Title)—The Champion's Fear
segments.recap: Velvet Thunder faces the undefeated Scarlet Widow one final time before losing her Women's Title at Warzone, and the paranoia consumes her.

segments.title: Contract Signing: RAZE vs. Iron Sovereign—Winner-Take-All at Warzone

beats.text: Next week at Warzone, everything comes to an end—or begins anew.
beats.speaker: pbp

lines: RAZE, Iron Sovereign—this is it. Winner-Take-All. The World Title. The promotion's future. Sign.
RAZE. Next week, you learn the price of challenging the divine right to rule.
I've held this title longer than you've drawn breath.
At Warzone, the anarchist falls, and order is restored.
Order? You call slavery order!
That title means nothing to me. It means EVERYTHING ends.
At Warzone, I burn it all down, Sovereign. Welcome to the revolution.

beats.text: The contract sits on the table. RAZE and Iron Sovereign lock eyes.
beats.speaker: pbp

exchange.speaker: riot_king
exchange.text: Not if we have anything to say about it!

segments.recap: The contract is signed for the federation's final match: a Winner-Take-All War where RAZE will challenge Iron Sovereign for the World Title and the soul of WZW.

segments.title: Contract Signed—Last Stand and CHAOS at War

beats.text: The Last Stand versus CHAOS! Bodies flying everywhere!
beats.speaker: pbp

segments.recap: As both factions clash at ringside, Riot King and the Last Stand make their stand against CHAOS while the Sovereign's World Title hangs in the balance.

segments.title: The Predator's Darkest Hour

lines: Look at this! My federation, torn apart!
Luxe, Cipher—you've won for now.
But at Warzone, the corporate machine WILL make its final stand. And one of you will PAY for this betrayal!

segments.recap: Apex Predator appears alone, watching the chaos unfold—his empire shattered, his allies scattered, his paranoia at its peak as he realizes CHAOS owns the federation.

segments.title: Chrome Warrior's Cryptic Message

lines: Riot King. The convergence approaches. What you have already chosen... I have already seen.
At Warzone, the timeline branches. Not CHAOS. Not corporate control.
Something... new.

segments.recap: Chrome Warrior appears backstage with a mysterious message for Riot King, hinting that the future is already written—and it favors neither faction, but a third path.

segments.title: Main Event: Iron Sovereign vs. Apex Predator—The Last Alliance

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: The World Champion and the Corporate Enforcer—united by necessity, divided by pride!

moments.speaker: color
moments.line: The Predator still has fire in him. Luxe didn't break him completely.

moments.speaker: riot_king
moments.line: That's it, Sovereign! One more time!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: The Iron Sovereign is measuring him for the Throne Breaker!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: The Throne Breaker! One, two, three! Iron Sovereign retains!

moments.speaker: pbp
moments.line: The World Champion stands tall one final time before Warzone. Next week, RAZE comes for this title—and everything changes.

lines: RAZE. I am still the Sovereign. And next week, at Warzone, you learn what it means to face a GOD!

segments.recap: The World Champion faces the isolated Predator in a display of force, as the Sovereign and Predator's alliance—though fragile—proves the corporate machine still has teeth one week before the end.
